Do you have a sample capture that (better) exercises this?  I guess the one I was using didn't expose (most) of these bugs.

The capture in #19379 demonstrates the segmentation, but doesn't explicitly feature the problem since it has no captured traffic.

The problem was in my suggestion to use the `text` variable (that only holds the payload from the current segment) instead of the buffer (that also included the header) in !20015.

This MR keeps track of the start of the payload in the buffer so that we can pass it to `blf_set_xml_channels`.

The rest is just code cleanup, mainly string duplications that are no longer needed, since the strings coming from the XML library are already null terminated.
